notes.title: Layer Tabs Update: Enhanced Preview and Renaming
notes.notes: Now, the layer tabs for the crosshairs display a small preview to help you identify them clearly. You can also rename layers by double-clicking or right-clicking the tab. Additionally, when you hover over a tab, it will be highlighted on the designer's canvas, making it easier to identify.

notes.title: The App Can Now Be Hidden in the App Tray!
notes.notes: You can now hide the app in the App Tray to keep your workspace neat. Even when hidden, the crosshair will remain active and fully functional. If you'd prefer to disable this feature, you can do so anytime in the Settings page.

notes.title: New 'Draw' Page
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971928/5f1879be263908ebf2e098187ccc4a60c5561557.jpg[/img]

The drawing feature now has its own page, making it more accessible and easier to use. You can also draw in multiple colors and customize your palette.

notes.title: Import crosshairs from Counter Strike 2
notes.notes:
You can now import crosshairs directly from Counter Strike and use them in any game. 

To import a CS2 crosshair, click the 'Import from CS2' button and paste the crosshair configuration code. You can then save and edit it from the EZ-Crosshair editor. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971928/e3a553009eb12b3ce19bb4e2ad22e18eb39ed290.png[/img]

notes.title: Custom Themes!
notes.notes: You can now choose to let the app adapt to your operating system's theme or use your own custom theme.

notes.title: Game Bar Extension Bug Fix
notes.notes: For some players the crosshair was not appearing in the game bar extension widget. This has been fixed in this update.

notes.title: Export crosshairs as PNG images
notes.notes: Added functionality to export crosshairs as PNG images.

notes.title: Exclusive Fullscreen Support!
notes.notes:
An EZ-Crosshair extension has been added, featuring a Widget for the Microsoft Game Bar. This allows you to use the crosshair in 'exclusive fullscreen' mode.
To install and configure the widget, go to the app's settings page, there you will find the steps to follow.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/CLVk0NJN/1d202146daf64997b8f99d9b92b6ebe0.png[/img]

[i]This feature is in beta phase.[/i]

notes.title: You can now upload and download crosshairs from the Steam Workshop
notes.notes: The Steam Workshop API has been integrated into the app, meaning you can see and use the best crosshairs from the community. You can also see your friends' crosshairs :)

notes.title: Added support for controllers
notes.notes: You can now use your controller to animate your crosshairs (Beta).
